name: Kirihara Karen
source:
The school's current Student President. Very beautiful; boasting princess-like etiquette, appearance and manners on the outside. But she is actually hardheaded and stubborn.

In [url=/v7233]Shiritsu Onsen Gakuen[/url], she came up with the idea of having all girls wear swimsuits in the school bathhouses and she strongly supports it. She is very determined to get her idea approved.
